query: SELECT Med_drug.active_ingredients, Med_disease.disease_name, Med_disease.sequelae, Med_drug.side_effects FROM disease JOIN drug ON disease.disease_name = drug.disease_name WHERE Med_disease.disease_name = 'Metastatic Colorectal Cancer' OR Med_drug.administration_route != 'injection' OR Med_drug.recommended_usage = 'after meals';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。 源SQL存在未绑定表限定符：Med_disease, Med_drug；图原样保留，字段归属待核，不能直接执行。所需字段：Med_disease.disease_name, Med_disease.sequelae, Med_drug.active_ingredients, Med_drug.administration_route, Med_drug.recommended_usage, Med_drug.side_effects, disease.disease_name, drug.disease_name
